items.action: None, unless a table must keep the faint resize line it had: set `--ds-table-resize-line-color: var(--border-default)` on that `ds-table`.
items.appliesWhen: A `ds-table` with `dsTableResize`. A table without it draws no resize line.
items.verify: At rest, a resizable `ds-table` header shows a `--text-tertiary` line at each column edge, unless `--ds-table-resize-line-color` is set.

items.action: None, unless a panel of your own is painted with `--surface-overlay` and fills a hover, pressed or selected state with `--surface-secondary` or `--surface-muted`: declare `--surface-secondary: var(--surface-overlay-secondary)` and `--surface-muted: var(--surface-overlay-muted)` on that panel. A panel that floats over other content like a popover takes `--surface-overlay-raised` as its fill and `--surface-overlay-raised-secondary` / `--surface-overlay-raised-muted` in those two declarations.
items.appliesWhen: The dark theme (`data-theme="dark"`) only: `--surface-overlay` is `--neutral-100` there, the value `--surface-secondary` has, so a hover in that colour on your own overlay no longer shows. `ds-modal`, `ds-drawer` and the `ds-app-layout` rail below `lg` paint `--surface-overlay`; `ds-popover`, `ds-menu` in it, the dropdown panels of `ds-select`, `ds-multi-select` and `ds-autocomplete`, `ds-date-picker`, `ds-time-picker`, `ds-color-picker`, `ds-tooltip-panel` and `ds-toast` paint `--surface-overlay-raised` (`--neutral-150`). Each sets its level's tokens itself. Light values are unchanged.
items.pitfall: A dark-theme `--surface-secondary` or `--surface-muted` override on `:root` no longer reaches inside the library overlays, which read `--surface-overlay-secondary`, `--surface-overlay-muted`, `--surface-overlay-raised-secondary` and `--surface-overlay-raised-muted` there; override those as well.
items.restore: :root[data-theme='dark'] { --surface-overlay: var(--neutral-0); --surface-overlay-secondary: var(--neutral-100); --surface-overlay-muted: var(--neutral-150); --surface-overlay-raised: var(--neutral-0); --surface-overlay-raised-secondary: var(--neutral-100); --surface-overlay-raised-muted: var(--neutral-150); --border-overlay: var(--border-default); }
items.verify: In the dark theme open a `ds-select` inside a `ds-modal`: the modal is lighter than the page, the panel lighter than the modal, and a hovered option lighter than the panel; a panel of your own painted with `--surface-overlay` shows its hovered row lighter than itself.

items.action: None, unless a timeline must keep the faint ring it had: was `--border-strong`, now `--text-tertiary`; set `--ds-timeline-node-border-color: var(--border-strong)` on that `ds-timeline-item`.
items.appliesWhen: A `ds-timeline-item` with no `status` and the default or `muted` tone. Items with a `status` or another tone draw their own ring.
items.verify: A `ds-timeline-item` with no `status` and the default tone draws its marker ring in `--text-tertiary`, unless `--ds-timeline-node-border-color` is set.

items.action: None, unless the app builds a `ToastRef` object itself: give it an `update` member, for example `update: () => {}`.
items.appliesWhen: An object literal or class typed as `ToastRef` in the app, usually a test double standing in for `ToastService.show()`. A ref returned by `ToastService` already has `update`.
items.verify: Every object the app types as `ToastRef` has an `update` member, and the app compiles.

informational: New component `ds-inline-edit` (`InlineEditComponent`): text renamed in place, with a two-way `value`, `(saved)`, `placeholder`, `maxLength`, `disabled` and `ariaLabel`. Adds the optional `DsIntl.inlineEdit` keys `rename` and `saved`. Nothing to change in your code.

New component `ds-splitter` (`SplitterComponent`, `SplitterOrientation`, `SplitterOverdrag`, `SplitterPane`): two projected panes with a draggable, keyboard-operable handle, a two-way `size` in px, `defaultSize`, `min` / `max`, `orientation`, `pane`, `overdrag`, `persistKey` and `ariaLabel`. Adds the optional `DsIntl.splitter.label`. Nothing to change in your code.

New components `ds-chat-message`, `ds-chat-thread`, `ds-chat-attachment`, `ds-chat-steps` and `ds-chat-step` (`ChatMessageComponent`, `ChatThreadComponent`, `ChatAttachmentComponent`, `ChatStepsComponent`, `ChatStepComponent`, types `ChatMessageRole`, `ChatMessageStatus`, `ChatStepStatus` and `ChatStepsEnter`), in the entry point `@ids-group-ltd/ids-design-system/components/chat`: chat bubbles with `[steps]`, `[attachments]` and `[actions]` slots, an agent's steps for the `[steps]` slot, and a list that stays at the newest message unless the reader scrolled up, groups runs and splits them by time. Adds the optional `DsIntl.chat` keys. Nothing to change in your code.

informational.text: `ds-tree` takes `<ng-template dsTreeTrailing let-node>` (`TreeTrailingDirective`, `TreeTrailingContext`) drawn at the end of every row, a `(nodeHover)` output, and `selection: 'single' | 'multiple'` (`TreeSelection`) with a two-way `selectedIds` in multiple mode. Each row is a focusable `div role="treeitem"` instead of a `button`, and a disabled row is reached by the arrow keys and announced as disabled. Nothing to change in your code unless your styles select the row as a `button`.
informational.verify: Open a `ds-tree` with a disabled node: rows look as before, ArrowDown stops on the disabled row with a focus ring, and Enter on it selects nothing.

informational: New component `ds-attachment` (`AttachmentComponent`): a file chip with a type tile or image preview, name and size, for the `[chips]` slot of `ds-chat-input`. Adds `AttachmentKind` and the optional `DsIntl.attachment` keys. Nothing to change in your code.

New component `ds-chat-input` (`ChatInputComponent`): an auto-growing message box with `[attachments]`, `[chips]`, `[actions]` and `[send]` slots, Enter to submit, `busy` / `busyLabel` and `(filesPasted)`. Adds the optional `DsIntl.chatInput` keys `label` and `send`. Nothing to change in your code.

informational.text: A focused `ds-table` resize handle draws no outline; its line becomes `--focus-ring-width` wide in `--focus-ring-color`, inset `--space-1` from the cell's top and bottom. Forced-colours mode keeps the outline.
informational.verify: Tab to a column resize handle: the line at the column edge turns the focus colour and wider, with no ring around the handle.

informational: `ToastService` can fold repeated toasts into one `×N` stack under `provideDsConfig({ toast: { groupDuplicates: true } })`, or by `ToastOptions.groupKey`; off by default. Adds `ToastOccurrence`, `ToastEntry.groupKey` and `ToastEntry.occurrences`, the `ds-toast` input `occurrences` and output `occurrenceClosed`, `ToastRegionComponent.stackFor`, an `occurrences` key in the patch `ToastRegionComponent.update()` accepts, and the optional `DsIntl.toast` keys `showAll`, `hide`, `dismissAll` and `repeated`. Nothing to change in your code.

informational.text: Under `data-theme="dark"`, `--shadow-1` to `--shadow-4` and every `--shadow-*` and `--ds-elevation-*` alias built on them are near-black at 30% to 60% alpha instead of a light glow, `--shadow-4` adds a 1px light hairline at 8% alpha, and `--shadow-tint-l` is `3%`.
informational.verify: In the dark theme open a modal and a popover and read their computed box-shadow: every layer is a dark rgba, and the modal's first layer is `0 0 0 1px` at 0.08 alpha.

informational: `ds-timeline-item` takes `status` (`TimelineStatus`: done, running, pending, error), a `[trailing]` slot at the end of the heading row, and a `[details]` slot behind a chevron toggle with a two-way `expanded`. Adds the optional `DsIntl.timeline` keys `done`, `running`, `pending`, `error` and `details`, and `TimelineComponent.firstItem` and `lastItem`. Nothing to change in your code.

informational.text: A `ds-timeline-item` wrapped in its own element inside `ds-timeline` draws its connector to the next item; only the last item of the timeline draws none.
informational.verify: Wrap each `ds-timeline-item` of a `ds-timeline` in a `div`: every item but the last shows the vertical line under its marker.

informational.text: Under `data-theme="dark"` the border of `ds-popover`, the dropdown panels, the `ds-date-picker`, `ds-time-picker` and `ds-color-picker` panels, `ds-tooltip-panel` and `ds-toast` is `--border-overlay`, which is `--border-strong` in dark and `--border-default` in light. `--ds-popover-border-color`, `--ds-dropdown-panel-border-color`, `--ds-date-picker-border`, `--ds-time-picker-border`, `--ds-toast-border-color`, `--ds-toast-border-color-info`, `--ds-toast-border-color-success`, `--ds-toast-border-color-warning`, `--ds-toast-border-color-error` and `--tooltip-border-color` default to it instead of `--border-default`; set one to `var(--border-default)` for the previous border; a value you set on them still wins.
informational.verify: In the dark theme open a `ds-select` and read the computed border colour of its panel: it equals `--border-strong`.

informational.text: `--ds-popover-bg-color`, `--ds-dropdown-panel-bg-color`, `--ds-date-picker-bg-color`, `--ds-time-picker-bg-color`, `--ds-toast-bg-color`, `--ds-toast-bg-color-info`, `--ds-toast-bg-color-success`, `--ds-toast-bg-color-warning`, `--ds-toast-bg-color-error`, `--ds-toast-queue-bg-color` and `--tooltip-bg-color` default to `--surface-overlay-raised` instead of `--surface-overlay`; the two are equal in light. Set one to `var(--surface-overlay)` to paint that overlay at the modal's level.
informational.verify: In the dark theme open a `ds-popover` and read its computed background: it equals `--neutral-150`.

informational: The ring of an upcoming `ds-stepper` step is drawn in `--text-tertiary` instead of `--border-strong`, so it reaches 3:1 against the surface. Visual only. Nothing to change in your code.

informational.text: The marker of a `ds-timeline-item` centres vertically on the heading, description and time together, or the text on the marker when the text is shorter; an open `[details]` area does not move it, and the connector also runs above every marker but the first.
informational.verify: Open a `ds-timeline` whose items have a description and a time: each marker sits at the middle of its text block and the line reaches it from the item above.

informational.text: The icon inside a `ds-timeline-item` marker is 16px instead of 15px and draws its line at stroke 3 on the 24-unit grid instead of 1.75, as thick as the 2px ring.
informational.verify: Open a `ds-timeline-item` with an `icon`: the icon is centred in the ring and its line is as thick as the ring.

informational.text: The step number inside a `ds-stepper` circle is wrapped in its own inline-block `span`, moved down by 0.033em, so it sits in the middle of the circle. Visual only.
informational.verify: Open a `ds-stepper` with an upcoming step and compare the number with its circle: the digit is centred vertically, not a fraction of a pixel high.
